**EON Download Manager** — downloads that finish. Several connections per file, resume after anything, a new link for an expired one, your browser's downloads and the videos a page plays. Free, open source, no account, no telemetry.

Early alpha (formats `v0`): for trying out.

**Install:** download the file for your system and run it; nothing else is needed. For the browser: in the window, *Settings → Connect browsers*, then unzip `eon-download-manager-extension-*.zip` and load it in `chrome://extensions` (Developer mode → Load unpacked). **Firefox:** open `eon-download-manager-extension-*-firefox.xpi` in Firefox and choose *Add* — Mozilla-signed, listed nowhere (added shortly after the release is published).

**Not signed** — EON has no signing keys yet (plan, madde 30 and 34). Check the files against `SHA256SUMS.txt`. On Windows, Smart App Control (if on) refuses unsigned downloads.
